gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: The divers ___ (know) to have been working without insurance.
gaps.explanation: are known to have been working: the knowing is present, the working was ongoing before.

gaps.sentence: The passengers ___ to fasten their seatbelts as the plane entered the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'The passengers were told to …' — passive of 'tell somebody to do'.
The results receive the action: 'will be announced'.

gaps.sentence: The whole docklands area ___ (REDEVELOP) at present.
gaps.explanation: 'At present' signals an ongoing process: is being redeveloped.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ while the family was on holiday.
gaps.explanation: Ongoing during the holiday: past continuous passive were being + opened.

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.
